title: Andruha DLQ Envelope v1
description: Universal operational envelope for poison, unparseable or unsupported Kafka messages across any topic. Diagnostic fields must never contain user content, credentials or exception text.

deadLetterId.description: Unique identifier of this dead-letter record.

consumer.description: Stable service name of the consumer encountering the failure.

topic.description: Source Kafka topic where the failed message was consumed from.

keyBase64.description: Original raw Kafka record key in base64, or null if key was absent.

code.description: Stable diagnostic error code without dynamic user text or private parameters.

stage.description: Processing lifecycle stage where failure occurred.

retryable.description: DLQ is strictly for non-retryable failures. Transient errors must be retried before DLQ.

originalValueBase64.description: Exact original raw Kafka record value for controlled replay/redrive. Never expose or log as plaintext.
